g.text: Takeaway: tolerance is two-sided — sit on the efficiency peak with a high-NA beam (NA 0.4 TE / 0.55 TM),

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: then hold alignment to well under a micrometre: 0.6 um of offset already costs 1 dB of excess loss — TM is narrowest.
